description: Purged 1/7-day measured soil-moisture forecasts, expanding backtests and honest historical-error intervals

issues.title: Evaluate operational latency and genuinely forecast weather
issues.body: Current origin-day inputs are retrospective finalized observations. Measure sensor/reporting latency and compare actual weather forecasts on a new untouched period.

issues.title: Extend external-site validation and time-block uncertainty
issues.body: Current forecasting evidence is one Missouri reference site with incomplete periods. Add independent sites and time-block resampling; do not retune the inspected 2023–2024 test.
